index_returns.description: Calculates the percentage return of each index over the last 3 months.
index_returns.sql: WITH recent_index AS (SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, close FROM market.index_eod WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.index_eod)), recent_performance AS (SELECT index_symbol, (MAX(close) - MIN(close)) / MIN(close) * 100 AS return_pct FROM recent_index GROUP BY index_symbol) SELECT index_symbol, return_pct FROM recent_performance;

leading_sectors.sql: SELECT sector, AVG(relative_strength) AS avg_strength FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) GROUP BY sector ORDER BY avg_strength DESC LIMIT 3;

risks.description: Lists the indices that have negative performance on the latest trading day.

sql_templates.description: Retrieve the latest sector ranking based on breadth and stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_dates AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_snapshot_date FROM breadth.sector_daily), 
latest_sectors AS (
    SELECT sd.sector, 
           sd.breadth_signal, 
           ma.stage2_pct
    FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
    JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ma ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
    WHERE sd.snapshot_date = (SELECT max_snapshot_date FROM latest_dates)
)
SELECT sector, breadth_signal, stage2_pct 
FROM latest_sectors 
ORDER BY stage2_pct DESC, breadth_signal
